content.value_statement: APIs often fail because authentication, validation, and abuse controls are inconsistent. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical patterns for safer API design.
actual_capabilities: Explains secure API authentication flows using JWT, refresh tokens, and protected routes.
Shows authorization checks for ownership and role-based access control.
Provides input validation examples for SQL injection prevention and request schema validation.
Covers rate limiting, throttling, Redis-backed limits, and security headers.
Lists API security checklists, common pitfalls, and OWASP API Top 10 topics.
limitations: Provides guidance and examples; it does not run automated security scans.
Examples must be adapted to the application framework, data model, and threat model.
It does not verify live infrastructure, deployed headers, or dependency versions.
Most implementation examples focus on Node.js, Express, Prisma, Redis, and Zod.

use_cases.title: Design a Secure API Endpoint
use_cases.description: Plan authentication, authorization, validation, error handling, and rate limits before implementing a new endpoint.

use_cases.title: Review API Security Controls
use_cases.description: Check an API design against common risks such as weak auth, SQL injection, verbose errors, and missing throttles.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Guidance
use_cases.description: Create shared checklists and review prompts for API security work across a development team.

prompt_templates.title: Create API Security Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a security checklist for this API endpoint. Cover authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, errors, and sensitive data handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design Authentication Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate design for user login and token refresh
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a secure JWT authentication flow for this API. Include login, refresh tokens, token expiration, secret handling, and logout considerations.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Endpoint
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an endpoint before release
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this API endpoint for security risks. Identify missing authorization checks, validation gaps, injection risks, verbose errors, and abuse controls.

prompt_templates.title: Model Abuse Scenarios
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced threat modeling for critical workflows
prompt_templates.prompt: Threat model this API workflow against OWASP API Security Top 10 risks. Prioritize attack paths, likely impact, controls, and test cases.

output_examples.input: Secure a new user profile endpoint.
output_examples.output: A prioritized checklist covering authentication, ownership checks, input validation, sensitive field filtering, generic errors, and rate limits.

output_examples.input: Review a login and refresh-token flow.
output_examples.output: A concise report that flags brute-force exposure, token storage risks, weak secrets, missing revocation, and unsafe error messages.

output_examples.input: Plan rate limiting for public and authenticated APIs.
output_examples.output: A tiered rate-limit design with stricter authentication limits, distributed storage guidance, response headers, and monitoring recommendations.

best_practices: Validate every input and use parameterized queries or a safe ORM for database access.
Check authorization for each resource, not only authentication for the route.
Use short-lived tokens, strong secrets, HTTPS, rate limits, and generic production errors.
anti_patterns: Do not concatenate user input into SQL queries or command strings.
Do not expose stack traces, database errors, token values, or secret names in API responses.
Do not rely on authentication alone when users can access or modify specific resources.

faq.question: Does this skill execute security scans?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, examples, checklists, and review prompts for API security work.

faq.question: Which API styles does it cover?
faq.answer: It discusses REST, GraphQL, and WebSocket APIs, with most code examples focused on REST patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with OWASP API Security Top 10?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps common design and implementation checks to OWASP API Security Top 10 risks.

faq.question: Does it replace a penetration test?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare and review API controls, but manual and automated testing are still needed.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Are the examples production ready?
faq.answer: They are reference patterns. Adapt them to your framework, data model, compliance needs, and operational controls.
